texts.zh:
随着[crucible_system.GetName]恒星系被占领，我们的军团夺取了那座环绕恒星建造的星系熔炉。

这座巨型建造物的沦陷，宣告了其缔造者以武力称霸星系的美梦破碎。
texts.en:
With the capture of the [crucible_system.GetName] system, our forces have also taken control of the Galactic Crucible that was being built around the local star. 

The loss of this megastructure shatters any remaining hope its creators had of taking over the galaxy by force.

label.en: We can make use of this.
